policy.meaning: Aliases reconcile a curated evaluation concept to one source-qualified record in the frozen snapshot.
policy.minimumEvidence: The source title and metadata must match the intended statistical product; a merely similar title is not enough.
policy.unresolvedTreatment: Unresolved aliases remain evaluation gaps. They must not be silently mapped to a neighbouring product.

qualifications.deaths-occurrences-weekly: The mapped product contains registrations and occurrences; the exact time basis remains a required comparison field.
qualifications.economic-inactivity-rate: The mapped regional APS product is grouped by inactivity reasons; it is an alternative rather than a generic headline-rate series.
qualifications.unemployment-rate-lfs: Nomis APS percentages contain the internationally defined measure; dataset-specific dimensions must still be inspected.
